incident.summary: Logical authority/deliberation admission existed, but the raw ChatGPT GitHub connector remained outside Python ActionCoordinator and all five current registered production repositories had no ruleset. Direct production writes therefore remained physically possible outside the intended admission path.

root_cause: Policy decision and policy enforcement were conflated.
Observed-HEAD CAS was treated as normal production promotion even though CAS is concurrency control rather than access control.
Host control surfaces were initially classified as hardening/limitations instead of part of the production mutation invariant.
The failure was first scoped to UAOS main, but registry-wide inspection showed the same missing enforcement boundary on every current production repository.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: direct-main noop connector write occurred despite logical mutation rules
ChatGPT GitHub plugin permission observed as app-specific Allow all actions

GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected: a correct model-side/Python admission gate is enough when another writer bypasses it
